[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.list.basic

def implementation (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) : Bool :=
let n := numbers.length;
if n ≤ 1 then
  false
else
  have h_numbers_len: 2 ≤ n := by
    linarith
  let rec loop (i: Nat) : Bool :=
    if i = n then
      false
    else
      have h_i_in_range: i < n := by
        linarith
      have h_i_plus_1_in_range: i + 1 < n := by
        linarith
      have h_j_in_range: i + 1 < n := by
        linarith
      let j := i + 1;
      let diff := (numbers.get! i) - (numbers.get! j);
      if abs diff < threshold then
        true
      else
        loop (i + 1)
  loop 0
[END]
